title: Weak adversarial tensor neural network for high-dimensional Fokker-Planck equations
summary: Solving high-dimensional stationary Fokker-Planck (SFP) equations remains challenging. Recently, deep learning methods have shown great potential for solving high-dimensional SFP equations due to their universal approximation and mesh-free training. However, the high-dimensional integrals involved in loss computation and normalization can be expensive to approximate accurately using Monte Carlo integration. To address this issue, we propose a weak adversarial tensor neural network (WATNN) method for solving high-dimensional SFP equations, which combines a weak adversarial (WA) formulation…
